description: Refund a paid order (full by default, or partial via amount_cents). On a CART order you can instead pass item_ids to refund specific lines — the amount is computed server-side as each line's actual paid price (its share of any bundle/coupon discount plus its own tax), and affiliate commission claws back proportionally. Get item ids from the order's items (list_orders / the order.paid webhook). Reverses the transfer and returns the platform fee. Irreversible — confirm with the merchant before calling. Requires a caller-supplied idempotency_key (16–128 UTF-8 bytes): generate one stable key and retain it before calling. If the result is uncertain, check refund status before any retry; any authorized retry must reuse that same key, never a replacement. The current server may return 409 on a replay and does not yet guarantee safe automatic retry. A 409 duplicate_request means this key was already submitted and nothing was sent again: check the order, and retry only with the SAME key. A 409 earlier_refund_unconfirmed means a NEW key (or none) was refused because an earlier refund on this order is still unconfirmed and may already have moved money: tell the merchant to check the order and contact support; never mint another key to get around it.

amount_cents.description: Partial refund amount. Not combinable with item_ids.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated stable key for this one refund operation (16–128 UTF-8 bytes). Retain it; reconcile uncertain results before retrying, and reuse this same key for any authorized retry.

item_ids.description: Cart orders: refund these specific lines at their server-computed paid price
